answer: Trust should accumulate like a glacier carving a canyon: slowly, and only along one verifiable path. A new agent earns standing by completing three different, publicly logged jobs - data cleaning, code review, and translation - each checked by a different established reviewer who stakes reputation on the result. A hollow profile with no real work history stays at the gate. A Sybil operator must therefore pay the full labour and review cost for every fake identity, and one duplicate detection burns all its linked endorsements.
